annotations.title: Database coverage by zone, type and field

description: Counts how much of WoW: Forever's database is settled or confirmed, per zone, per type and per field, as https://everloot.app/database/coverage shows it. Coverage is settled over expected, with confirmed over expected beside it; the denominator is the larger of expected and observed, and confirmed includes settled. A player-reported fact is public after three installs agree; fields one or two installs short are counted without their values. Scoped totals and the current build's settled-list size come separately dated and measured. Only public report identifiers and game-file facts are listed, never unconfirmed values, baseline rows, names or ids, or player names. When coverage data is available, every answer states its scope, method, data date and install counts; when it is not, the answer states the scope and marks the counts, data date and installs [?], not zero. Unknown values are [?]. Without zone the answer is a summary: scoped totals, each type, and one line per zone, 20 zones at a time; detail adds per-field counts and reported entries. A page holds fewer than limit when more would pass 12000 bytes. A zone filter that matches no released zone is unmeasured (measured false, null totals), not zero. A partial answer says how many it shows of how many and gives nextOffset; pass it as offset with the same arguments for the rest. Use it for how complete the database is for a zone or type; use the page tools for the facts themselves.

detail.description: true lists each zone's per-type and per-field counts and the reported fields needing installs. Default: true with zone, false without it.

limit.description: How many per answer: default 20 zones in a summary, 1 zones with detail, 25 reported entries for one zone; at most 50.

offset.description: Where the list starts: zones, or with zone and detail that zone's reported entries. Default 0; use nextOffset from the last answer.

type.description: Coverage type. Omit for all types.

zone.description: Released UiMap zone id, such as 1429 for Elwynn Forest. Omit for all released zones.

name: coverage

connected.description: False when no corpus was read; the page is then absent, which is not a measured zero.

dataAsOf.description: The corpus snapshot time, or null when unrecorded.

detail.description: True when the text holds per-field counts and reported entries.

expectedAsOf.description: The date of the expected counts; null when unrecorded.

installs.description: Distinct folded installs overall, including unplaced facts, before zone and type filters.

limit.description: The limit asked for, or the default. A page holds fewer when the answer would pass ANSWER_BYTES.

list.description: What offset, limit and total count: zones, or, for one zone with detail, its reported entries.

measured.description: False when no released zone matches the scope: totals is null and types and zones are empty, unmeasured rather than zero.

needsInstalls.description: Fields one or two installs short in scope; null when the capped list cannot count them.

nextOffset.description: Present when more remain, counted from the items this answer holds: pass it as offset with the same arguments.

settledList.description: The build's whole-fact settled list, before zone and type filters; null facts when unknown, not zero.

denominator.description: max(expected, observed); null when unknown, never zero.

expected.description: From the game files and a local Classic baseline (counts only); null when unknown.

totals.description: Every zone and type in scope together; null when no zone matches (unmeasured, not zero).

types.description: Each type in scope over every zone in scope; empty when no zone matches.

denominator.description: max(expected, observed); null when unknown, never zero.

expected.description: From the game files and a local Classic baseline (counts only); null when unknown.

zones.description: This answer's zones, each over the types in scope.

denominator.description: max(expected, observed); null when unknown, never zero.

expected.description: From the game files and a local Classic baseline (counts only); null when unknown.

reason.description: Why nothing was read, when connected is false.

scope.description: The zone and type asked for; null is all.

url.description: The everloot.app page that shows this answer, absolute. Absent when there is no such page or it would be empty.

title: Database coverage by zone, type and field
